card.name: HY at start of HYPER- words
card.fires_on: The capitalized piece HY just before PERSENSITIVITY or PERKALEMIA in all-caps warning text. It also fires on a few words that come right before an 'excess' term, such as Iron before Overload.

modes.label: HY before PER-
modes.description: The first piece of an all-caps HYPER- word in a warning heading or sentence.
modes.example: USP IS INSTITUTED, CAREFUL INQUIRY SHOULD BE MADE TO DETERMINE WHETHER THE PATIENT HAS HAD PREVIOUS<< HY>>PERSENSITIVITY REACTIONS TO

modes.label: Other words before excess terms
modes.description: A linking or heading word that comes before a word about excess or greater exposure.
modes.example: Incorrect dosing of a given formulation may result in underdosing and loss of therapeutic effect and possible development of resistance<< or>> possible clinically significant adverse reactions from greater exposure

card.writes: It pushes toward super- and sup- word starts, so the pattern is odd and weakly tied to the output.
card.plain: It marks the start of an all-caps word like HYPERSENSITIVITY or HYPERKALEMIA in warnings.
